high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article titled "Kaveri Marine Gas Turbine Gets a Second Wind: DRDO Revives Program with Dry Kaveri Core." The article was published on February 12, 2024, by the admin of IDRW.ORG TEAM. The main focus of the image is a photograph of a marine gas turbine, specifically the Kaveri Marine Gas Turbine, which is being showcased as part of the DRDO's revived program. The turbine appears to be in a workshop or testing facility, as evidenced by the industrial setting and various equipment around it.
